title: SMOK TFV16 Lite 2ml Vape Tank
description: The TFV16 Lite Tank from Smok is the vaping giant’s latest iteration of one its best ever sub-ohm tanks, and one that has flagship written all over it. At a glance, the TFV16 Lite is a more compact version of the original TFV16, but it still has the same incredible performance as its big brother. The TFV16 Lite is designed for use with Smok’s advanced nexMesh coil technology for incredible flavour and performance and features a conical mesh coil and a dual mesh coil out of the box. The TFV16 Lite is capable of holding up to 2ml of e-liquid and features a button-activated top filling mechanism, making the tank safer to travel and reducing the risk of leaks. The tank features an adjustable dual airflow, which lets you tailor the intensity of the draw to your exact preference. The TFV16 Lite’s 510 connection means you can pair this tank with most vape devices. Ideal for high-powered, sub-ohm kits . Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
